meta.title: Auction closes without award when End Price is reached with no acceptance
gaps: Verify that the closed Dutch auction has no awarded vendor.
Verify that every Dutch auction round passes without vendor acceptance until the End Price is reached.
Verify the auction's End Price and Dutch-auction-specific closing behavior.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the closed Dutch auction has no awarded vendor.; Verify that every Dutch auction round passes without vendor acceptance until the End Price is reached.; Verify the auction's End Price and Dutch-auction-specific closing behavior.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live Dutch auction.
Wait for the live bidding window to lapse naturally without forcing an acceptance or award.
Return to the events list to inspect the auction's resulting status.
Open the history tab where a closed auction should appear.
Assert that the auction is shown as closed after reaching its end.
